visual_goal: Show pricing as a loop: signals from valuation, market and stock feed rules, rules make proposals, only the dossier changes the price, the price event fans out, and outcomes judge the rules.
prompt: A clockwise loop illustration with exactly nine labeled boxes, each label appearing once. Top left corner: two small boxes stacked vertically, a gauge box labeled 'Vantage' above a market chart box labeled 'Pulse'; there is no arrow between 'Vantage' and 'Pulse'. To their right, at the top center: a box labeled 'Signal generator'. Top right: a gear box labeled 'Rule engine'. Right side, below 'Rule engine': a desk box labeled 'Pricing desk' showing a plain monitor with a simple line chart and no currency symbol. Left side, middle: a single folder box labeled 'Dossier'. Bottom row, left to right: a pipe box labeled 'Event backbone', a box with portal screens labeled 'Channels', a pie chart box labeled 'Outcomes'. Arrows: one diagonal arrow from 'Vantage' to 'Signal generator'; one separate diagonal arrow from 'Pulse' to 'Signal generator'; one arrow from 'Dossier' up to 'Signal generator'; one from 'Signal generator' to 'Rule engine' labeled 'signals'; one from 'Rule engine' down to 'Pricing desk' labeled 'proposals'; one long arrow from 'Pricing desk' left across the middle into 'Dossier' labeled 'set price'; one from 'Dossier' down to 'Event backbone'; from 'Event backbone' one arrow to 'Channels' and one separate arrow along the bottom to 'Outcomes'; one tall arrow from 'Outcomes' up the right edge into 'Rule engine' labeled 'judges rules'. Draw no currency signs at all.
alt: Vantage, Pulse and the dossier feed a signal generator; the rule engine turns signals into proposals for the pricing desk; the desk sets the price in the dossier; the price event goes to channels and outcomes, and outcomes judge the rules.

visual_goal: Show a repricing run: simulate, approve in bulk, write absolute prices at the expected version, and treat a retry as a duplicate.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with four vertical lanes, each headed by an icon and a label: a desk with a person labeled 'Pricing desk', a gear labeled 'Rule engine', a folder labeled 'Dossier service', and a relay tower labeled 'Relay'. Horizontal arrows, top to bottom: from 'Pricing desk' to 'Rule engine' labeled 'simulate'; from 'Rule engine' back to 'Pricing desk' labeled '412 proposals'; from 'Pricing desk' to 'Rule engine' labeled 'approve 396'; from 'Rule engine' to 'Dossier service' labeled '€17,450 at v41'; from 'Dossier service' back to 'Rule engine' in green labeled 'applied v42'; from 'Rule engine' to 'Dossier service' labeled 'retry'; from 'Dossier service' back to 'Rule engine' in grey labeled 'duplicate'; from 'Dossier service' to 'Relay' labeled 'latest price'. Exactly eight arrows.
alt: Swimlanes for the pricing desk, rule engine, dossier service and Relay: a simulation yields 412 proposals, 396 are approved, €17,450 is written at version 41 and applied as version 42, a retry is a duplicate, and Relay receives the latest price.

visual_goal: Show the life of a price proposal, including expiry when its reference is a day old or the car changed.
prompt: A simple state map of six rounded tiles. Left: blue 'Proposed'. Center: teal 'Approved'. Right: green 'Applied'. Top: red 'Rejected'. Top left: grey 'Superseded'. Bottom center: orange 'Expired'. Exactly six arrows: one from 'Proposed' to 'Approved' labeled 'approved'; one from 'Proposed' up to 'Rejected' labeled 'with reason'; one from 'Proposed' up to 'Superseded' labeled 'newer proposal'; one from 'Proposed' down to 'Expired' labeled '24 hours'; one from 'Approved' to 'Applied' labeled 'expected version'; one from 'Approved' down to 'Expired' labeled 'version changed'. A small clock icon inside 'Expired'.
alt: Proposed goes to Approved, Rejected with a reason, Superseded by a newer proposal, or Expired after 24 hours; Approved goes to Applied at the expected version, or Expired when the version changed.
